description: This file defines the BOMNode class, which represents a node in a Bill of Materials (BOM) tree within a manufacturing context. It includes methods for loading children and parent nodes, substitution logic based on manufacturing rules, configuration, order creation, and various utility functions related to BOM structure management.

classes.name: BOMNode
classes.description: Represents a node in the BOM tree, encapsulating product details, hierarchy, substitution rules, and methods for building and managing BOM structures, including order creation and configuration.

methods.name: loadChildren
methods.description: Loads the child components of the current BOM node based on product associations, applying configuration rules and handling substitutions.

methods.name: loadParents
methods.description: Recursively loads the parent nodes of the current BOM node based on product associations.

methods.name: substituteNode
methods.description: Handles the substitution of a BOM node based on manufacturing rules and product features.

methods.name: configurator
methods.description: Configures a BOM node, potentially substituting it based on manufacturing rules, features, and variant lookups.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Calculates the earliest start date for production based on child nodes and proposed orders.

methods.name: isWarehouseManaged
methods.description: Determines if the product is managed within a warehouse (has stock targets).

methods.name: isManufactured
methods.description: Determines if the product is considered manufactured, based on child nodes and supplier availability.

methods.name: isVirtual
methods.description: Checks if the product is virtual based on a 'isVirtual' attribute.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrder
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders and related work effort records for this BOM node and its children.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Outputs a textual representation of the BOM structure for debugging.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Aggregates products that are contained within package boundaries.

methods.name: sumQuantity
methods.description: Summarizes quantities of products across nodes, aggregated by product id.

methods.name: setParentNode
methods.description: Sets the parent node in the BOM hierarchy.

methods.name: getParentNode
methods.description: Returns the parent node in the BOM hierarchy.

methods.name: getRootNode
methods.description: Returns the root node of the BOM tree.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity associated with this BOM node.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity for this BOM node.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of this node within the BOM tree.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product represented by this BOM node.

methods.name: getSubstitutedNode
methods.description: Returns the substitution node, if any, for this BOM node.

methods.name: setSubstitutedNode
methods.description: Sets the substitution node for this BOM node.

methods.name: getProductForRules
methods.description: Returns the root product ID used for applying rules.

methods.name: setProductForRules
methods.description: Sets the root product ID for rule application.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Gets the BOM type ID for this node.

methods.name: getQuantityMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the quantity multiplier for this node.

methods.name: setQuantityMultiplier
methods.description: Sets the quantity multiplier for this node.

methods.name: getRuleApplied
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing rule applied to this node.

methods.name: setRuleApplied
methods.description: Sets the manufacturing rule applied to this node.

methods.name: getScrapFactor
methods.description: Returns the scrap factor for this node.

methods.name: setScrapFactor
methods.description: Sets the scrap factor for this node.

methods.name: getChildrenNodes
methods.description: Returns the list of child BOM nodes.

methods.name: setChildrenNodes
methods.description: Sets the list of child BOM nodes.

methods.name: getProductAssoc
methods.description: Returns the product association (relation record) for this node.

methods.name: setProductAssoc
methods.description: Sets the product association for this node.

methods.name: setTree
methods.description: Associates this node with a BOMTree.

methods.name: getTree
methods.description: Returns the BOMTree this node belongs to.
